label: HEALING

cover.headline: The holidays *after a breakup*
cover.sub: 5 ways to get through the season gently.

points.heading: Plan for the hard moments
points.body: Family questions, empty traditions. Knowing what’s coming helps.
points.panel: “I’d rather not talk about it today, but thanks for asking.”

points.heading: Make one new tradition
points.body: Something that’s just yours this year, however small.
points.panel: Pick one cozy ritual: a movie night, a walk, a new recipe.

points.heading: Say yes to good company
points.body: Spend time with people who make you feel lighter.
points.panel: “Can I come over for a bit this weekend?”

points.heading: Go easy on social media
points.body: Everyone’s highlight reel is extra shiny this time of year.
points.panel: Mute a few accounts for the season.

points.heading: Let it be imperfect
points.body: Some moments will sting. That doesn’t mean you’re not healing.
points.panel: “It’s a hard day, and I’m still okay.”

caption:
The holidays can make a breakup feel louder: the traditions, the questions, the photos everywhere.

You don’t have to love every moment this year. You just have to be gentle with yourself while you get through it. These five steps can help.

Save this for the season, and share it with someone who might need it too.
